data.name: Rasyid
data.gender_notes: Rasyid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who owns, master, possessor, ruler, governor, chief, leader, commander. The name Rasyid carries the meaning “Owner, master, possessor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rasyid usually hope their child will grow to embody owner, master, possessor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who holds the power to guide and protect others
data.etymology: Rasyid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Owner, master, possessor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rasyid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رشيد
in_arabic.meaning: من يهتدي في الحياة ويتبع الصراط المستقيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشيد هو الشخص الذي يهتدي في الحياة ويتبع الصراط المستقيم، و يعني الهداية و الاستقامة على الطريق الصحيح، وردت في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَن يَهْدِي اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِي وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ وَلِيًّا مُرْشِدًا'، وتدل على صفة من صفات الله تعالى، وهي الهداية.

in_urdu.name: راشد
in_urdu.meaning: جو زندگی میں صحیح راستے پر چلتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: راشد وہ شخص ہے جو زندگی میں صحیح راستے پر چلتا ہے اور سیدھا راہ اختیار کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جیسے کہ رشادہ جو کہ ہدایت اور راہ داری کے معنی میں ہے، اسلامی تقليد میں راشدین کا ذکر اہم ہے، خاص طور پر راشد خلفاء کے حوالے سے، جنہوں نے اسلامی ریاست کی سربراہی کی اور عدل انصاف کے ساتھ حکمرانی کی.

in_hindi.name: राशिद
in_hindi.meaning: जो जीवन में सही रास्ते पर चलता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: राशिद वह व्यक्ति है जो जीवन में सही रास्ते पर चलता है और सीधा रास्ता अपनाता है, यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से लिया गया है, जैसे कि रशादा जो हिदायत और राहदारी के अर्थ में है, इस्लामी परंपरा में राशिदीन का उल्लेख महत्वपूर्ण है, विशेष रूप से राशिद खलीफाओं के संदर्भ में, जिन्होंने इस्लामी राज्य की अध्यक्षता की और न्याय के साथ शासन किया.

in_pashto.name: راشد
in_pashto.meaning: چا په ژوند كې سم لاره اختياروي
in_pashto.long_meaning: راشد هغه څوک دی چا په ژوند كې سم لاره اختياروي او دى د هغو کسانو ځانګړتیا ده چى په سمه لاره روان دي، دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخستل شوى دى، لکه رشادہ چې د لارښوونې او سمې لارې د اخستلو معنى لري، په اسلامي دود كې د راشدينو يادونه مهمه ده، په ځانګړي ډول د راشد خلفاء په اړه، چا چې د اسلامي دولت مشري يې وکړه او د عدل او انصاف سره يې حكمراني وکړه.

in_english.name: Rasyid
in_english.meaning: One who is guided, follows the right path
in_english.long_meaning: Rasyid is a significant name in Islamic tradition, derived from the Arabic root 'r-sh-d' which means to guide or to be guided. The name signifies one who follows the right path and is guided in life. In the Quran, guidance is a recurring theme, emphasizing the importance of seeking and following the right path. Historically, the term 'Rashidun' refers to the first four caliphs of Islam who were known for their justice and righteous leadership. The name Rasyid embodies qualities of guidance, wisdom, and adherence to the true path.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rasyid signifies power, authority, and leadership in the Islamic community. Historically, many prominent figures with this name have held important political positions, such as sultans and caliphs. The naming of children after these individuals reflects the cultural value of leadership and governance.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its literal meaning of possession or mastery, the name Rasyid also carries spiritual significance. In Islamic teachings, Allah (God) is the ultimate master and possessor of all things, and the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ serves as a model of leadership and guidance for the Muslim community. Hence, bearing the name Rasyid signifies a striving to embody and follow the example of Allah and His Prophet, leading a virtuous and righteous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Owner, master, possessor" symbolizes One who owns, master, possessor, ruler, governor, chief, leader, commander. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rasyid serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of owner, master, possessor.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Rasyid was a prominent figure in the 13th century Malay Sultanate of Singhasari in East Java, Indonesia.
historical_references.context: Rasyid was a Malay ruler during the Singhasari period in East Java, Indonesia.
